headline: Six stocks show rising RSI momentum
hook: Technical momentum signals for six listed stocks
summary: Six Indian stocks, including Ircon International and Aegis Logistics, have recorded an upward trend in their Relative Strength Index (RSI). The RSI is a technical momentum indicator that measures the magnitude of recent price changes to evaluate overbought or oversold conditions. Traders often use this metric to identify potential trend reversals or the continuation of existing price momentum. This data reflects current technical positioning rather than fundamental business changes.
why_it_matters: Technical indicators may signal short-term price volatility for these stocks.
